title: Q221 read-only versioned archive catalogue inventory

method.requests: Exactly one read-only metadata POST per frozen target fiscal year; agency=all; type=contracts

hypotheses.H1: The current monthly catalog lists at least two distinct dated full archive versions or two distinct dated delta archive versions in at least one target fiscal year.
hypotheses.H0: No target fiscal year exposes a multi-date archive series in the returned catalog.

outcomes.DATED_ARCHIVE_SERIES_FOUND: Only permission to design a separately reviewed small row-presence experiment. Not proof of historical first-public time.
outcomes.ARCHIVE_LISTING_OK_NO_VERSION_SERIES_FOU: Stop this archive-vintage route; do not expand scope or download broad archives.
outcomes.ARCHIVE_LISTING_EMPTY: Stop and diagnose source availability; no public-clock conclusion.
outcomes.ARCHIVE_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: Preserve the failure receipt; do not infer from partial catalog results.
outcomes.REQUEST_REJECTED: No API call is authorized or made.

prohibitions: Do not treat Action Date, Issued Date, Last Modified Date, file name, or updated_date as first-publication time.
Do not infer public absence from absence in a historical archive.
Do not download any ZIP payload in this inventory phase.
Do not change the 348 frozen transaction keys or their fiscal-year distribution.
Do not infer recipient-to-issuer mapping, scientific evidence, performance authority, holdout selection, ranking, tuning, promotion, orders, or live execution.
next_gate: Only after DATED_ARCHIVE_SERIES_FOUND may a separate reviewed workpack select the smallest eligible dated archives and a deterministic subset of frozen keys for row-presence testing; even then, only verified known-available-by-snapshot bounds are permitted until public availability timestamps are independently established.
